english.title: Fail to comply with duty to notify registrar when person ceases to have significant control
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default]_

to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied, which had confirmation that a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), had ceased to be a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company and confirmation of the date on which the person so ceased, and without reasonable excuse and within the required time limits, failed to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales in accordance with section 790LF of the Act stating the person’s name and service address and the date on which the person ceased to be a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790LF and 790LJ of the Companies Act 2006.
